'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a miscellaneous item, introduced by the DLC Stranger Sins, which can only be found when searching for a specific tavern artifact - [[Ancient Shackles]]. Its only known purpose is to be studied, which upon doing so will provide the item [[Research Obsidian]], along with a significant tech point bonus.

The [[Research Obsidian]] item can be used instead of a silver star book for the Astrologist last event. Doing so, however, locks the possibility of earning the "Best seller" [[Achievements|achievement]] for giving the [[Astrologer]] a gold star [[Book]].
